newsitem.title: FRANCE: French courier firm Taxi Colis to sell some shares.
newsitem.headline: French courier firm Taxi Colis to sell some shares.

text.p: French courier operator Taxi Colis said an undisclosed company would be taking a minority shareholding in its capital, with an announcement to be made early next month.
Taxi Colis' capital is currently owned by the company's chairman and two managing directors, a Taxi Colis official told Reuters.

Taxi Colis has a current agreement with Federal Express (FedEx) covering pick up and transport of documents and parcels in France by road to the U.S. express operator's southern Europe hub at Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport.
FedEx product services are marketed from Taxi-Colis distribution outlets in France.
FedEx provides its own pick up and delivery services in the Paris and Lyon areas.
A FedEx official told Reuters that FedEx was not the undisclosed company in question. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 F+5017
